 사진 확대 ‘2026 MAMA.’ Photo | Screenshot from Mnet’s YouTube channel The group ZEROBASEONE won the Worldwide KCONers' Choice at the 2026 MAMA AWARDS.
 Chapter 1 of the 2026 MAMA AWARDS, a leading global K-pop awards ceremony, took place at Kyocera Dome Osaka in Japan at 6 p.m. on the 20th.
 Taking the stage just after receiving the award that day, ZEROBASEONE said, “We believe we were able to receive this award thanks to our fans. It feels good to receive an award whenever it happens. We also want to express our gratitude to all the staff.”
 They added, “It feels good to receive an award whenever it happens. We’re preparing an album so that we can meet you with lots of activities next year. Please look forward to ZEROBASEONE next year, too. We’ll work hard to become great artists.”
 Meanwhile, the concept of the 2026 MAMA AWARDS is “A MUSIC INTERSTELLAR.” It depicts a journey of roaming among the stars of music beyond the boundaries of time and space, generations, and tastes, discovering and sharing music from different eras. The ceremony is being livestreamed worldwide through major digital platforms, including Mnet Plus.
 [Lee Da-gyeom, Star Today reporter]
